Docs-Source Consistency Audit — faultdeck · 2026-11-02 (G3 batch) ​

  • Scope: README.md / README.zh.md / docs/** / todo.md
  • Method: ~/workspaces/standards/文档与源码一致性审计规范.md (three buckets + six steps); every claim evidenced at file:line; negative conclusions verified the search path first
  • Fix direction: source-wins — docs move toward the tree, never the reverse

Key state of the repo ​

Updated 2026-11-03 (supersedes the original 2026-11-02 "no implementation" snapshot below the line): the repository now carries a working implementation — a six-crate Cargo workspace: crates/core (shared FaultSpec/Target/Injection model + validate_injection + management-network overlap check), crates/netem (tc qdisc/filter adapter with preflight, rollback, dry_run executor), crates/agent (resident daemon, token auth, Mode A/B transport, iptables firewall), crates/cli (faultdeck remote ping/inject/rollback), crates/report (Scenario, RunReport JSON/HTML, SHA-256 hash, compare_runs history diff), and crates/coordinator (multi-target hub: registry/heartbeat/report archive). crates/protocol is an empty placeholder, not a workspace member. The MVP plan's toxiproxy adapter and scenario YAML DSL remain unimplemented; todo.md milestones FD-P1-4, FD-ARCH-1, FD-REPORT-1, FD-ARCH-2 are checked.

Language face (browser auto-switch) ​

Probed with standards/scripts/fleet-url-contract.py faultdeck on 2026-11-14, then verified by hand because the probe's first-screen CJK window under-counts this repo:

URLstatuslangfirst-screen CJK
/200en8 (English page — correct)
/zh/200zh-CN240
/zh/quickstart200zh-CN464
/zh/architecture200zh-CN1340 (head 686)
/zh/configuration200zh-CN404
/zh/remote-agents200zh-CN677
/zh/reports, /zh/netem-faults, /zh/glossary, /zh/design/mvp-plan200zh-CN346 / 584 / 830 / 659

Verdict: form ② locale routing, healthy. docs/.vitepress/config.mts:71-76 declares locales: { root: {…}, zh: {…} } (no rootLang key — the root tree is the English default), / serving English and /zh/ serving the full Chinese page set — every zh page carries the zh-CN lang attribute and substantive translated body text. No auto-switch: no navigator.language / rootLocale redirect / Accept-Language detection anywhere in the config or theme/ dir; switching is the manual language link in the nav only. That is the accepted baseline ("manual switch + explicit link"), so no code change — recorded as a P2 decision item in todo.md (which repos opt into browser-language auto-redirect, fleet-wide, awaiting the user).

Probe artifact, for the fleet record: the script's CJK counter reported 4 for /zh/ even though the page is fully Chinese — the probe slices the raw HTML to 20 000 chars before stripping script/style, and this repo's head (inlined vitepress assets + the lean .js link list) fills that window. The zh/architecture and zh/glossary numbers above are from a body-aware recount (scripts/styles stripped first), which is the number to trust. Flagging so the fleet aggregation does not read faultdeck's "CJK 4" as thin content. The / triple's CJK 4, by contrast, is real and benign: the English hero contains exactly four CJK characters — the manual 中文文档 language link (docs/index.md:16). English page, lang=en, count correct. Source-side counts: docs/index.md 4 CJK (that link only), docs/zh/index.md 274 CJK — the zh homepage is substantive, not a placeholder.
